newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Eurobond issue pushes up Russian MinFins further.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond issue pushes up Russian MinFins further.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds firmed on Tuesday and dealers said the forthcoming issue of Russia's Eurobond remained the main positive factor.

"Trading started from levels higher than yesterday. The West supported this trend actively," one dealer said, adding the sixth and seventh tranches firmed 0.5 point recently after U.S. operators had joined trading.

Dealers said the Eurobond issue remained the main reason for the rise. The gradual return of President Boris Yeltsin to ruling the country and hopes the problem of frozen MinFins would be finally resolved were other factors, they added.
The Eurobond issue and MinFin thaw are already priced in, Sberbank dealer Pavel Sool said.
